title: Micah Bell's last stand on Mount Hagen in Red Dead 2
subject: micah
description:
Why do you think Dutch pulled the trigger? 👇

The final showdown between John Marston, Dutch and Micah Bell in the Red Dead Redemption 2 epilogue. Spoilers for Red Dead Redemption 2.

scenes.text: Eight years after Arthur died, John Marston found Micah on a mountain.
In 1907, Sadie Adler and Charles Smith rode with him up Mount Hagen, deep in the snow.
Micah had a new gang and a cabin full of the old Blackwater money.
And Dutch van der Linde was standing right beside him.
Three guns, three men. Dutch looked at John and said, "We can't always fight nature, John."
Then he shot Micah. John fired the last bullet, and Dutch walked away without a word.
John carried the money home and paid for his ranch at Beecher's Hope.
